rules.statement: Apply build-scroll-3d-product-story to the current car GLB and deliver a reviewable preproduction package through a fixed-duration five-shot animatic, without entering runtime implementation.

Document applicable automotive or technical product advertising cases from primary or creator-owned sources, extracting narrative thesis, transferable methods, and limitations for this concept car model.
Develop and compare at least two materially different car-story routes before selecting one candidate route for the animatic.
Author exactly five continuous shots with a narrative purpose, viewer takeaway, model action, camera, lighting, layout, transitions, rhythm, hold, copy, and truth constraints.

Base close-ups and component language on inspected GLB nodes and visible geometry; do not claim a verified production powertrain, manufacturing sequence, or engineering function that the concept asset does not establish.
Deliver a fixed-duration five-shot animatic that visibly expresses the selected route, camera intent, lighting progression, transitions, and comprehension holds.
The preproduction record must remain pending external confirmation; runtime-story generation must reject it until the user explicitly approves the route, script, and animatic.
Do not redesign, deploy, publish, or claim acceptance of the current WebGL car page during this preproduction task.
